title: Lesson 19. Internet safety
description: 5 safety rules and what to do in a risky situation

questions.prompt: What do you do if something online scares you?
questions.explain: You won't be scolded — they'll help.

questions.prompt: You can download games without grown-ups — viruses don't exist.
questions.explain: A virus — a computer illness — can come with a game.

questions.prompt: Match the situation with the right action
pairs: Don't type it, tell a grown-up
Close it and tell a grown-up
questions.explain: A grown-up helps in every case.
Nobody gives things away for free.

questions.text: If something scares me — I call a ___ at once.

questions.prompt: If a suspicious window won't close, click the buttons inside it.

questions.topic: The internet is like a city
questions.prompt: Why don't we chat with strangers online?
options: You don't know who is really writing
questions.explain: He may pretend to be a kid.

learn.intro: The internet is like a big city: lots of fun, but also strangers and tricksters. Let's learn the rules!

sections.title: The internet is like a city

slides.text: On the street you know the rules: don't talk to strangers, don't get in a stranger's car. The internet has rules too.

check.topic: The internet is like a city
check.prompt: Like a big city, the internet has tricksters.

slides.text: 1. I never share my password, surname, address, school or phone. 2. I never click "You won!" or "Free download". 3. I download nothing without a grown-up.
4. I don't chat with strangers — you never know who is really writing. 5. If something scares or confuses me — **I call a grown-up at once**. Nobody will scold you!

check.prompt: What must you never tell anyone online?
check.explain: A stranger could find out where you live.

slides.text: "You won an iPhone!" window popped up? **Don't click**, close it with the cross or call a grown-up. Nobody gives away phones for free.
The window won't close? Don't click anything inside — call a grown-up.

check.prompt: In a game a stranger asks which school you go to and wants to meet. What do you do?
options: Don't answer and tell a grown-up
check.explain: He may be pretending to be a kid.
